subject: Cannot load the tidyr library in shiny

messages.author: cc7aa3eda1034683
messages.subject: Cannot load the tidyr library in shiny
parts:
I made a shiny app that uses the tidyr package, specifically the spread and separate functions.

However, when I launch the app on a fresh restart of RStudio, I always receive an error message 'Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : could not find function "separate"'.

library(tidyr) is included with all the library declarations.  My workaround has been to manually evaluate library(tidyr) first, then running the app.

Is anyone else having this issue or does anyone know the cause of it?

Thanks!
